summary: the tool's lockfile walk stops at the workspace root the package manager itself resolves, never reading an unrelated ancestor's lockfile
acceptance: a lockfile in an ancestor the program's workspace does not include is never read
tests: a lockfile in an ancestor outside the workspace is not read
notes: Class 0101: the manager is the runtime here. From TOOL-LOCKFILE-READ-FINDS-THE-MANAGERS-LOCK's note: a stray ~/package-lock.json draws false tool.unlocked; a lone yarn.lock refuses the run. Cite pnpm (pnpm-workspace.yaml) and npm (`workspaces`) root rules from fetched docs before encoding. Shares src/tool.rs with PACKAGE-MANAGER-FIELD-NAMES-THE-MANAGER.
